atoms.b: There are over 600 muscles in the human body which are connected to the skeleton by ((++tendons fats)). When muscles ((++contract_and_relax jump_and_run)), they pull bones with them and make the body move.

instruction.text: True or false? Read the sentences about muscles, and choose the correct answer.

atoms.a: Muscles are attached to the skeleton with fat.
Muscles pull bones when they contract, making the body move.
There are 206 muscles in the human body.
Tendons attach muscles to the skeleton.

atoms.b: Muscles ((++always never)) work in pairs to create movement. This has to be the case, because each muscle can only ((++pull push)) on a bone.
One muscle will contract and ((++shorten lengthen)), while the other will relax and get ((++longer shorter)). Then when you need to move in the opposite direction, they will swap jobs.

hint.text: Try for yourself! Bend your arm to match the picture and try to feel the different muscles contracting and relaxing.

atoms.b: When we ((++exercise rest)), our muscles can become sore and achy. It’s important that we eat enough protein, so that they can ((++repair hurt)) themselves.
